method: Native RGB threshold R<135,G<110,B>1.1R; 4-connected bbox; boundary-touching profiles excluded; lymph-like profiles only (reference is acute tissue)
output_method: Same threshold; isolated compact profiles, same 300x300 native screen ROI; edge-touching objects excluded.
oriented_axes_method: PCA principal direction of thresholded pixels within each accepted bbox; projected extent plus projected unit-pixel support. Transverse width includes curvature, not minimum local nuclear thickness. Same threshold and native resolution.
